name: Pituitary Adenoma

category.name: General Systemic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
MRI of the pituitary gland with and without contrast within the last 12 months confirming tumor size.
Copies of all prior clinical records, laboratory testing, and imaging for this condition.
A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with an ophthalmologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam.
Visual field graphs (24-2 or 30-2) with clinical interpretation by the treating eye specialist performed no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.
Any other testing/studies accomplished for the diagnosis or treatment.
If evaluated by surgeon (neurosurgery or ENT), submit a copy of the progress note from the office visit including discussion of surgical recommendation.
All items in Row B
Hospital records pertaining to surgical resection:
b. Discharge Summary
c. Operative Reports
d. Pathology reports

rows.evaluation_data: Submit the following for FAA review: - 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with their treating endocrinologist no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It should include a summary of the history of the condition or diagnosis; current medications, dosages, and side effects (if any); clinical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment and plan (prognosis); and follow-up. It must specifically include whether surgical intervention is recommended. - 2. MRI of the pituitary gland with and without contrast within the last 12 months confirming tumor size. - 3. Copies of all prior clinical records, laboratory testing, and imaging for this condition. Note: If functional tumor (secreting), please also refer to appropriate page (Acromegaly, Cushing’s, etc.) for additional requirements
